Eithew way, watch out fow the bouwders he thwows, they sutn! {{sic}} (☉_☉)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 30 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Prepare for a POWERFUL boss!|Beginning of Wave 30 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|TANK!!!!|Beginning of Wave 39 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Tank''', previously known as the '''Tank 1''', is a large and tanky boss that appears in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. The '''Tank''' is a fast, high health [[Enemies|enemy]], with speeds similar to the [[Quick]] and much higher health than the [[Giant Boss]]. It can be a major threat to unprepared defenses. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Tank''' has a khaki-grey skin color and a grey cobblestone torso and legs. It has chains wrapped around its torso, left arm and right leg. Its right arm is slightly bigger than its left arm. It has rusted rebar impaled into its back and the top of its torso is beveled. The '''Tank''' has glowing red eyes, which have slanted tops to express anger, and no mouth. It runs hunchbacked and uses its right arm to push itself forward. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Tank''' is a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a tannish-grey skin color as well as a reddish-brown torso, waist and legs. It has black armbands with grey spikes and abs with tumors and wounds on its chest. The lower sides of its limbs are coated in dried blood and its body is covered in dirt. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Tank''' had a khaki-grey skin color and a grey cobblestone torso and legs. It had chains wrapped around its torso, left arm and right leg. Its right arm was slightly bigger than its left arm. It had rusted rebar impaled into its back and the top of its torso was beveled. The '''Tank''' had a drooling zombie face with glowing red eyes, which had slanted tops to express anger. It ran hunchbacked and used its right arm to push itself forward. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Tank''' had a tannish-grey skin color and black pebble pants on its legs. It had long muscular arms and a large torso and legs. It walked slightly hunchbacked and had a drooling zombie face with glowing red eyes. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Tank''' is similar to the second version, except it had brown pants. }} ==Strategy== *Fast firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Turret]], are recommended to kill '''Tanks'''. **The [[Commander]] can boost their firerate with its ''Call to Arms'' ability. *Because of the '''Tank's''' fast speed, long range towers, such as the [[Ranger]], are recommended, as the '''Tank''' will take more time to get out of their range. **The [[DJ Booth]] can also help increase range of towers that have shorter range, such as the [[Accelerator]] or the [[Minigunner]]. **It is recommended to use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost the [[Ranger]]'s firerate. *You can use slowing towers, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]], [[Brawler]] or [[Sledger]] to slow down the '''Tank'''. **Slowing it down is generally favored, due to the '''Tank's''' obscene speed. **Be aware that, due to the '''Tank's''' large size, the [[Warden]] and freezing towers can only slow the '''Tank''' down for a shorter period of time compared to an average-sized enemy. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:CarrierScream.ogg]] |When the '''Tank''' dies (16 June 2019 – 29 October 2020) |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Tank0.png|Third version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) Tank-0.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) Tank-1.png|First version (16 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseTank.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} B7c7f6fa86bcabb01df77e2d666e090b.jpg|'''Tank''' on the game thumbnail. Tower Defense Simulator- 🌵 BADLANDS Trailer! 🌵|'''Tank''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} TankEnemyIconIG.png|'''Tank''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Tank''' originally had an ability called ''Rock Throw'' where it would throw boulders at towers. This would stun them for a period of time. **This ability was based on the ''Left 4 Dead'' zombie, the [[w:c:left4dead:The Tank|Tank]]. **When the '''Tank''' was first added, the ''Rock Throw'' could vary in velocity. It could go far, or it could crumble right upon the first tower it hit. ***The bits of rock that the boulder split into also had irregular hitboxes. **The boulders could be blocked by a player's torso. *The first two versions of the '''Tank''' had arms taken from the {{RLinkBU|299|Superhero}} package in the Roblox catalog. **The first two versions of the '''Tank''' resembled the [[w:c:r2d:Tank|Tank]] from ''R2D'' and are likely a reference to said game. *Unlike its counterpart, the [[Speedy Boss]], the '''Tank''' cannot be spawned from the [[Mystery Boss]]. **This is likely due to the '''Tank''' having a high amount of health and a very fast speed, which would make the game incredibly difficult if it spawned from [[Mystery Boss]]es. *The current appearance of the '''Tank''' is similar to the [[w:c:left4dead:The Charger|Charger]] from ''Left 4 Dead 2''. **It could also draw inspiration to the current [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Boss4|Boss4]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The [[Commander]]'s dialogue suggests the '''Tank''' can throw boulders. However, this never happens in-game. **This is because the dialogue was made during [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], where the '''Tank''' still had its ''Rock Throw'' ability. The dialogue was not changed for the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. ***The dialogue also suggests that the '''Tank''' used to play in Baseball leagues. *The '''Tank''' was a sendable enemy in [[PVP Test]] since the first test, however, it could not actually be sent as it only had 25 waves. **This was not the case since the second test, as it was extended to 30 waves there. **Its stats were also not finished, with both its speed and health being set to 0. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''16 June 2019''' -
